content: In order to project the output features of the encoder into a singer and pitch invariant latent space, a singer classification network and a pitch regression network are employed to force the encoder not to encode singer and pitch information. The singer classification loss and pitch regression loss are added adversarially to the reconstruction loss to train the entire model end to end.
